provenance.method: Owner-authorized HTTPS POST; certificate validation enabled; redirects disabled; 20-second timeout; 1 MB response limit
provenance.scope: Read-only discovery of the supplied account and its one visible heater
provenance.redaction: Envelope projected to status fields; device/account values replaced with placeholders
provenance.limitations: OFFLINE is cloud connectivity, not requested power; isFault false does not establish healthy live telemetry
